notes: Terror Invasion (new): "Terror Invasion: Hunt the Terror" (General, next to the Terror Invasion claim, off by default) hunts today's Terror up to the daily "Hunt N times" quests, with the heroes that deal it the most damage including the event's bonus hero type
Terror Invasion: the damage achievements are claimed from today's best hit on the Terror, so the 2,000+ damage tiers are no longer missed

Choice chests (new): "Open choice chests" (General > Misc, off by default) opens choice chests such as the Kingdom Labors Selection Chest on the item you picked for each one - set picks in "Choose picks..." or tick "Remember this pick" when opening one from the bag
Choice chests: picks are skipped while the bag, storage or collection can't take the item (gear needs free cabinet space, skins and portraits you already own are not opened again)
Bag: choosing an item from a choice chest opens the item you picked, and confirming with nothing selected no longer opens the first one
Spending (new): "Never spend Giftable Gems" keeps every gem purchase the bot makes within your Linked Gems
Treasure Trove: deposits only Linked Gems above your reserve, as the Trove pays back Linked Gems
Gift Shop: gem gifts are checked against your Giftable Gems, and say "Not enough Giftable Gems" when short
Diamonds: the account list's second "Gems" column, the auto-buy reserve and the Mall messages say Diamonds again - Diamonds are a separate balance from Gems

Star Event (new): "Players outside the guild" sends Popularity to the players you name (comma-separated) before your guildmates, and works without a guild - "Send Popularity to guild" is now "Send Popularity"
Star Event: Popularity is sent again every game day - it stopped after the first day when the bot ran just after UTC midnight
Star Event: the log names who received your Popularity
Vergeway: the hard stages (99 and 92-163) are played from ready-made solutions, so accounts with maxed cards get past stage 163
Vergeway: a lost battle on a normal stage is retried up to 3 times before the stage is marked stuck
Vergeway: accounts no longer sit idle for minutes after login while the battle simulator is busy - the bot waits 15 minutes and carries on with other tasks, and the wait survives a reconnect
Vergeway: Verge Shards stop at the 65,535 cap instead of dropping to near zero on maxed accounts
Vergeway: the battle log names the chapter and stage 1-15 instead of "Stage 18"
Realm gathering: marches are spread evenly over the resource types you tick, instead of each picking one at random
Realm gathering: while a daily Gather quest is open, realm marches collect that quest's resource
Chaos Arena: gather quests send marches that can empty a tile, smallest first, so the quest moves on instead of picking full level 5 tiles
Chaos Arena and Solo Battlefield: an account is not sent into one while it is inside the other
Solo Battlefield: unticking Auto Enter brings home an account the bot was keeping inside once its troops are home (unless nest attacks are still on)
Equipment: an upgrade target set on one copy of a gear piece applies to that copy only, so a second copy is no longer taken to Mythic - targets set in the craft tab still cover every copy
Hell Events: the "Only for medals of" list always offers Watcher and Chaos Dragon medals
Building: the Rent second queue button no longer says "Insufficient Gems" when the account has the gems
Rallies: Rally Options says when the game's own Darknest Auto Join picks the troops
Guild Fest: the Remove tab tooltip now says a mission is removed when its points are below Min Points or above Max Points
Templates and Global Settings: a gear target set on one copy covers that item on the other accounts, and applying settings no longer stops other accounts sending Popularity that day
Accounts: when this copy of the bot has no accounts but another install on the PC does, a message names that folder so you can open or update the right one
Chat bot (new): /info, /shields, /restart, /mute, /unmute and /problems commands, and /startall and /stopall can take a tag
Chat bot: /status shows a summary and only the running accounts ("/status all" lists everyone), and /version shows the running version and whether an update is out
Chat bot (new): Telegram gets a "/" command menu and buttons to pick the account for start, stop, log and shortlog

Chat bot: Discord slash commands find accounts by any part of the name or the start of the IGG ID, offer only stopped accounts for start and running ones for stop, and answer errors instead of hanging on "thinking"
Chat bot: alerts are combined into one message, retried when a send fails and held while the chat bot reconnects, and reconnects keep trying instead of giving up after 3 tries
Chat bot: Telegram admin pings now notify, and names with special characters show correctly
Chat bot (new): "Post new versions in chat" (Other Settings > Chat Bot, on by default) posts once when a new version is available
Connection alerts (new): "Only after offline for (min)" next to Connection Status Change only posts when an account is still offline after that many minutes, then posts again when it is back
Connection alerts: quick reconnects no longer post "Connected" every few minutes, and repeated "Reconnecting" in one outage posts once
Lords Monitor (new): Telegram alerts as well as or instead of the Discord webhook

Lords Monitor (new): Telegram alerts as well as or instead of the Discord webhook
Vergeway (new): a Vergeway tab in Hero settings plays the Verge Guardians stages for you - the battle simulator picks the deck and plays each battle, including the hard late stages

Vergeway (new): card upgrades (smart, own copies only, or off), Verge Shard use, free and key Verge Chests (keys only, never gems) and Strength in Numbers, with a status line showing the next stage and why one is stuck

Hero Stages: Priority Mode reworked - it pushes the next normal and elite stage, then farms trophies and medals in your hero priority order, and hires, equips, crafts for and ranks up your priority heroes (other heroes' crafting and rank-ups follow "Enhance Heroes")
Hero Stages: new "Trophies First" option (on by default) makes Priority Mode farm trophies before medals
Hero Stages: Priority Mode starts spending at 60 stamina, stays within the chapters you have unlocked, and leaves a stage alone after 5 failed tries until your heroes get stronger
Hell Events: new "Train to Army targets during Hell" option (off by default) stops Hell training at your Army tab troop targets
Hell Events: "Only for medals of" can also accept Chaos Cores, Bright Talent Orbs and Brilliant Talent Orbs ("or materials"), counting only rewards up to your target phase
Hell Events: training moves on to the next troop type when one cannot be trained, instead of stopping
Lucky Cards: new "Exchange the cards for gems" switch (on by default) - untick it to only scout chests and do the exchange yourself
Lucky Cards: "Exchange as soon as every slot is a 9" now works when you hold more cards than you have unlocked slots
Hunting (new): "Attack guild-summoned monsters" hits the monster your own guild leader summons (such as the Hoarder), even with normal hunting off
Hunting: choose the monster level Saberfang targets (1-5, default 3), and hunting no longer stalls when no monster of that level is nearby
Hunting: hunting in the Mirage no longer restarts the account
Hunting: long Tycoon, Labyrinth or quest play runs no longer hold up hunting and other tasks until they finish
Kingdom Tycoon: Guild Fest and event Tycoon keep rolling instead of one coin every few minutes
Labyrinth: keeps playing after the bot activates a shield instead of pausing for 30 minutes
Quests: Guild Fest and Exchange missions that spend Holy Stars or Luck Tokens keep playing until done instead of one play every 2-3 minutes
Guild Fest (new): "Auto Sync Personal" keeps your personal Remove settings for 120% and 200% quests in step with Complete
Guild Fest: the 200% and 120% quest slots compare the boosted points, so they no longer skip high-point missions (old saved limits are converted)
Guild Fest: the gauntlet tier shows correctly in Russian and other languages
Darknest (new): "Keep game Auto Join DN active" keeps the game's own Auto Join switched on and renews it before it runs out - Guild Fest Darknest quests take over joining while they need it
Dark Essence: the game's own "auto clear below level" setting is kept in step with the bot's minimum essence level
Gathering: "Gather for the daily quests" sends gatherers only for what the open daily gather quests still need, even for resources unticked in Gathering
Gathering: your accounts no longer send armies to the same resource tile
Resource Supply: auto-supply keeps sending down to the reserve instead of stopping after a couple of carts
Resource Supply: carts queued while Snowbeast was active are resized when it ends, and the rest goes as another cart
Spending (new): "Auto buy with extra coins" spends Guild Coins above a maximum you set (1M-99M) on an item you pick (off by default)
Spending (new): buy Anti-Scout with gems when none is in the bag - choose 24 hours, 3 days or 7 days
Auto-buy: an item marked in one store is only bought in that store, including marks made in Functions > Buy store items
Auto-buy: older marks without a store apply to event stores only, never the Chaos Arena or Labyrinth stores
Auto-buy: the Bargain store list loads in Functions > Buy store items, and the bought counter updates when a new store event starts
Protection: the leader is sheltered even when no troops are home
Protection: a relogin no longer makes the bot think it holds no prisoners and release them by shielding
Protection: a refused heal or bag top-up waits 5 minutes instead of retrying every few seconds ("Error code: 2")
Familiars: the Gryphon's skill is kept for your own commands instead of being used automatically
Familiars: the skill stone merge list no longer shows a non-existent "Power Ring (Fencer)"
Solo Battlefield: "Skip alchemy when overheated" stops the batch at the overheat line instead of forging past it
Building: new accounts build a barracks before a manor, so they get past castle 5 (an account already stuck needs its manor demolished)
Army: the troop-target chapter you pick on the Army tab stays picked
Army Arena: an account no longer waits minutes for the battle simulator when picking an opponent
Relocate and Migrate: the buy-scroll prompt appears straight away
Accounts: accounts that went missing after updating to 6.10 are recovered automatically when you sign in (contact support if one still shows the old-account notice)
Settings: settings no longer revert on every restart on installs that still had an old leftover settings file
Settings: applying Global Settings or a template keeps a day-based guild-stats reset and the stats upload switch
Guild stats: exports stay at your set time after a daylight-saving change, with no early or double export
Guild stats: cache files older than 30 days are deleted (they could take over 1 GB on large installs)
PC Mod (new): "Update an existing PC Mod export on key refresh" (General > Advanced) rewrites an account's existing export whenever its key is refreshed
Sign in: a slow IGG server no longer holds an account's start for up to 45 seconds
Sign in: an account whose start failed because the login server was unreachable keeps retrying on its own
Sign in: closing the bot signs out, so reopening it straight away no longer says "You are already logged in"

Performance: much lower CPU use - the battle simulator uses at most half your CPU cores, Limited Challenge, Dare and story battle teams are shared between accounts and kept across restarts, and a stage your heroes cannot win is not searched again until they change
Performance (new): Simulator Status window (Settings > Simulator Status) shows what the battle simulator is doing and lets you change how many searches run at once
Performance: faster start-up with many accounts, quicker mail processing and less memory per account
Performance: Vergeway deck searches are kept across restarts and capped at 5 minutes
Interface: copying the log no longer fails when another program is using the clipboard
Interface: the hero views no longer crash with "Object reference not set" when the saved hero list has an empty slot
Guild Fest: a "Gather Resources" mission keeps gathering when no level 3-5 resource tile is nearby - it falls back to the tile levels you ticked in your gathering settings
Guild Fest: the tick column in the mission lists is now labelled "Take" (Complete tab) and "Remove" (Remove tab), with a tooltip saying what it does
Cleanup: a leftover file from older versions is removed from the lib folder automatically
Hell Events: "Finish builds with gems" (new, off by default) finishes a build that would still be running when the event ends, up to a gem limit per build

Hell Events: "Work while gathering" (new, on by default) lets Hell Event training, research, building, merging and hunting run while gatherers are out, and "Also general speed-ups" (new, off by default) lets Hell Events use general speed-ups
Hell Events: the phase targets are read again every hour, so accounts no longer stop part-way thinking the event is already done
Hell Events: troop training uses your full barracks capacity instead of the Army tab's training limit
Hell Events: "Only for medals of" lists only the heroes whose medals Hell Events actually give
Guild Fest: drag items in the Reward priority list to reorder them (the arrow buttons still work)
Guild Fest: the two mission types added in game 2.205 are removed like the others you ticked, without re-running Auto Config
Guild Fest: a ticked mission type with no maximum points now removes missions below its minimum
Quests: "Use Holy Stars" and "Spend Luck Tokens" now play the Labyrinth and Kingdom Tycoon instead of only opening the items, and "Encounter Elite Labyrinth Guardians" plays Elite mode
Quests: speed-up quests spend only the speed-ups the quest still needs instead of finishing the whole queue
Exchange Extravaganza: stops working on quests (and spending artifact coins) once every exchange has been used
Kingdom Tycoon and Labyrinth: played from chapter 6, when the game unlocks them, instead of chapter 8
Labyrinth: keeps attacking after opening Holy Star items, and a refused play no longer stops it until the bot is restarted
Auto-buy: an item marked in one store is only bought in that store - items marked before 6.9 still apply to every store, so unmark and mark them again to limit them to one
Familiars: skillstone merges no longer fail with "Error code: 12"
Hero Stages: "Attack Stages Sequentially" now continues through chapter 8 instead of going back to stage 1-1
Building: new accounts no longer get stuck around castle 7 trying to upgrade a Defense Tower that was never built
Building: a build the game refuses is skipped for a while instead of stopping all building and research
Building, research and training no longer wait for gatherers to return when auto gear switching is off
Guild Bank: !setgather now works correctly
Guild Bank: a member promoted by another officer is no longer refused commands with their old rank
Guild Bank: Unauthorize always removes the user from Authorized Users
Guild Bank: replies that had long titles, such as !adminbal in Thai, now arrive
Join Guild: an account on a guild's trust list can join even when it is below the might requirement
Relocate and Migrate: kingdoms above 1949 can be selected
Guild stats: resets happen on time across daylight-saving changes, follow changed reset times and templates straight away, and hunt reports no longer upload again every few minutes
ChatBot: the "Post incoming rallies / attacks" option is visible again (Settings > General > Advanced)
Performance: lower CPU use - Army Arena simulations use fewer threads (Performance Mode also shortens them)
Lords Monitor: no longer keeps closed "Lords Mobile PC" game processes running in the background
Guild Fest: "Spend Artifact Coins" is now in the Automate Quests table, so you can stop the bot spending artifact coins on it
Updater: no longer puts the desktop shortcut back on every update if you deleted it
Updater: no longer hangs on "Verifying signature" - if the check cannot finish it stops with the reason so you can try again
Sign in: error messages under the password box wrap and are no longer cut off
Auto KvK (new, off by default): gathers in a rival kingdom and recalls before the period ends
Guild Expedition (new): joins Guild Expedition building rallies
Guild Assembly Point (new): relocates to your guild's Assembly Point
Lucky Cards (new): scouts chests and exchanges cards for gems
Guild Showdown: picks a gear set, recalls armies before registering and can update the lineup shortly before registration closes
Hell Events (new): plays the hourly Hell Events, optionally only for the hero medals you choose, and can use speed-ups

Quest automation (new "Automate Quests" tab, Exchange settings): choose per quest type what the bot works on for Guild Fest and Exchange Extravaganza, with a limit per type such as items to keep or the energy % hunting waits for
Guild Fest: slot order, abandon timer, extra grid columns, guild mail and reward priority; mission names show without colour codes
Heroic Saga: can also refresh quests with Saga Compasses (off by default), aiming for a target grade and keeping a reserve
Daily quests: gathers when a daily quest needs it
Monster Hunting: new daily monster kill target
Commands: !setgather per resource and !train; !recall now always replies with what it recalled
ChatBot (new option, Settings > General > ChatBot): "Post incoming rallies / attacks" sends one webhook alert, tagging the admin, for each rally or attack on the castle

Auto-buy (new): tick items in any store to buy them automatically - event, Artifact, Labyrinth and Tycoon stores, the Shop (keep a number in the bag), Mall packs (once a day), weekly/monthly cards and subscriptions (renewed when they run out), Misc passes and Offers; Diamonds are only spent above the reserve you set
Auto-buy list (new): review and clean every marked item across this, the ticked or all accounts (Shop and Mall headers, Settings > General > Store, or Functions)
Buy store items (new, Functions menu): buy from the Shop, event and challenge stores on all ticked accounts at once
Stores: the right-click menu keeps Buy All instead of losing it a second after opening, and the challenge stores no longer open an empty menu
Global Settings and templates: also copy the quest automation table, and keep each account's own auto-buy marks
Messages from the Lords Bot team now show in the bot, each one once, with an info or warning icon
Supply: queued deliveries are cleared when the recipient leaves the guild, and gear-swapping actions wait while a speed-gear supply runs
Supply: a supply that drops the connection no longer sends the account into an endless reconnect loop
Supply: the resource grid no longer crashes with "Value was either too large or too small for an Int64"
Login: works when a system or SOCKS proxy is set
Login: starting an account while the bot reconnects to the Lords Bot server now waits for it instead of failing with "the login server could not be reached"
Login: "already signed in on another device" retries straight away the first time, then waits a little longer between tries (shown in the log) instead of retrying every second
Accounts: an account stuck logging in again and again now reloads itself
Accounts: account files saved by very old versions are no longer loaded - the bot lists any it skips so you can add them again

Account menu: Check Linking Status, Manage Logged In Devices and, where available, Steam login sit directly in the menu, with the web and store items in a sub-menu; Check Linking Status works on an account that has never run
Army Arena: restarted accounts no longer stall for minutes before deploying, and opponents are no longer refreshed for nothing
Hero Stages: "Attack Stages Sequentially" no longer repeats stage 1-1 once an account reaches chapter 8
Hero Hiring: free hires wait past the cooldown properly and retry sooner after a refusal
Familiars: merges skillstones
Building: Mana Chamber build priority, a "Refine Mana Crystals in the Mana Lode" switch (it used to be always on), and a building needed first no longer stalls behind the spam target
Cybertron: no healing inside, one-soldier lode gathers and AllSpark research first
Relocate: the coordinate list accepts the game's "X179 Y527" format instead of crashing
Monster Hunting: hunting no longer stops with an error when the wonder data didn't load

Settings: the new options have their own groups, General settings and the Armaments and Saga tab open faster, boxes line up with their labels on every tab, and long tooltips wrap instead of being cut off
Item, building and castle pictures use the current game art
Updater: waits for the closed bot to exit and retries files that are briefly locked (e.g. by antivirus) instead of failing the update, and removes leftover files from older versions
Lords Monitor: no longer freezes or crashes during long sessions, waits for a closed bot before restarting it, and writes a crash log
Fixed: "Fail Fast Exception" message when closing the bot

Fixed: the Monsters list and Army Colosseum info hidden at the bottom of their pages, Monsters tab scrolling, the exchange mission in the top slot never being cleared, and Global Configuration becoming unclickable
Fixed: item tooltips showing placeholders instead of values
Fixed: guild bank replies such as !adminbal not arriving in Thai and other non-Latin languages, and the Thai deposit check
Game 2.205: the hero list loads again on the new game version, which fixes Hire New Heroes re-hiring heroes the account already has and the gold figure used by gold supply
Armament and Battle Spirit (new, off by default, Settings > Heroes): Breakthrough, Battle Spirit upgrades and Armament enchant/recast using Heroic Saga items - never spends gems
Heroic Saga (new, off by default, Settings > Heroes): sends heroes on quests, finishes and claims them, uses free quest refreshes and claims the max-level reward
Heroes: new "Armaments and Saga" settings tab (before Hero Priority) with the live status of all three Heroic Saga quests and your Armament item counts

Armament Effects: pick the effects for each hero, or use the "Match Each Hero's Troop Type" and new "Match Each Hero's Skills" presets; works from Global Settings and templates, and each account keeps its own per-hero choices
Heroes tab: shows each hero's Battle Spirit and Armament
Hero Hiring (new card, Settings > Heroes): use free hires and, if you choose, hire with Hero Summonstones (1x / 10x) while keeping a reserve
Army Colosseum: the Colosseum store now shows in Inventory; goods locked to a higher division are hidden or shown locked, as in the game
Army Arena: only attacks opponents ranked above you
Unite Shop: items priced in two tokens show both prices and check both balances before buying
Tutorials: the new 2.205 Hero Arms, Heroic Saga and Ice Coming steps run the way the game does
Quests and rewards: daily, guild, VIP, turf, admin and labor quests, daily login, achievements, subscriptions, periodic cards and guild gifts claim correctly and stop retrying refused claims
Familiars, heroes and troops: pet skills, training, enhancing, EXP items, rune shattering, hero EXP and star-ups, troop training, traps and healing fixed to match the game
Building and research: the castle and other buildings the story needs are upgraded first, the log explains skipped upgrades, and research/building gates match the game
Gathering: a refused march no longer counts as sent, and march size includes your army-size buffs
Monster Hunting: stronger hero lineup search for the most damage per hit
Monster Hunting: accounts no longer post a monster to guild chat as if out of energy after a single hit
Shield: new accounts' newbie shield is respected, and the log says why a needed shield wasn't deployed
Shield: no more "Activated Shield" lines every 15 seconds while troops are deployed - the bot waits and tries again each minute
Hero Stages: Braveheart is no longer used straight after a sweep, which caused "Your actions are too fast" refusals
Hero Stages: new Status column showing passed stages
Guild Fest: solo rewards are now claimed during the event, the way the reward window does it
Guild Bank: replies (e.g. !adminbal) are sent at a pace the game accepts, so every player gets their mail; refused mail is logged
Guild Bank: each resource-help report is credited only once
Relocate: mass relocation buys the migration scrolls a move needs with guild coins, and says why a purchase fails
Solo Battlefield: settings no longer reset to defaults after every update
New accounts: story and villager ruins are rebuilt without the build errors seen on fresh accounts, and Vergeway stage 1 is no longer auto-played
Villagers: furniture upgrades are paced like real taps
Login: after a Monitor restart the bot keeps your saved sign-in, so auto-login works again
Login: fixed a crash after importing an account from WeChat
Share with Support (new, Bot Functions menu): send an account's settings to the support team with a note about the problem
Accounts: deleting or closing an account no longer crashes the bot
Accounts grid: column layout is saved as soon as you change it, so it survives a crash or restart
Creator Turf: new "Creator Turf" item in the account right-click menu opens the event page for that account
Inventory: Added event shops, Lucky Spin's Secret Trove and other open event shops show under the game's shop name, and their free items are claimed
Account menu: Purchase Diamonds, Copy AppCoins Link and Creator Turf now work on accounts that aren't running

Supply: fixed disconnects when supplying with speed gear - the bot locates the ally again after every gear switch, never supplies in the middle of one, and large supply waits until the login has settled
Guild Bank: commands sent by mail or chat (such as recall) no longer fire in a burst that could get the account disconnected
Army Colosseum: Global Settings now saves its options (Save Selected and templates)
Story: the story no longer repeats its dialogue every 30 seconds while waiting on a skirmish, and the log says when a skirmish needs "Attack Skirmish Levels" turned on
Marches: when the server rejects a march, the log shows the game's reason (e.g. too far away) as well as the code
Activity log: a dropped connection shows a one-line reason instead of a long error dump
Interface: the changelog window (Settings > View Changelog) has a new look matching the help site, grouped by feature with a version list

Base Organiser: new on the Building tab - rearranges your base into tidy street-grid layouts (Grouped, Symmetric with a centred castle, Compact, or a template saved from another account), spreads village buildings evenly, and shows a preview before anything moves

Base Organiser: decorations can be left, arranged, placed from storage or bought with gold (never gems) to pave paths, and extras can be packed away; progress shows on the Stop button and the bot pauses its other tasks while organising

Army Colosseum: new per-account option to play challenges and auto-deploy - opponents and the deploy are chosen by simulating the fight, challenges are paced like a player and stop at rank 1 (off by default)
Lucky Spin: new option to spin with keys you own at x1/x5/x10 - never buys keys (off by default); the daily collection and milestone rewards are claimed correctly
Roulette: spins you own are used automatically (new "Spin Roulette" option, on by default)
Stratagems: interest and capital are claimed, with an opt-in option to invest gems above a reserve
Mall: new Offers tab listing the event shops (item, hero stone, lord skin, forge, roulette, relic, coupon, bundle and more) - double-click to buy

Mall: week/month cards can be gifted to another player from the Passes tab, pack contents show in the Packs tab, and Misc lists the Daily Sign-In premium, event gold passes, Guild Expedition and Chaos Arena passes and Building Queue 2
Mall: most packs were missing from the Packs tab - their titles are now downloaded and shown
Mall: purchases, shop buys, gifts and mail only report success once the server confirms, and show the game's reason when something fails (not enough gems, player not found, ...)
Mall: double-clicking a row in Misc could buy the wrong row
Mall: free packs such as the event Daily Free Bundle are claimed
